title: Planet Crisis Response — Hurricane Melissa, Jamaica (2025)
description: High-resolution Planet SkySat and PlanetScope satellite imagery documenting Hurricane Melissa's impact on southwestern Jamaica, structured as a STAC catalog pairing post-event collects with a pre-event cloud-free baseline for before/after damage assessment.
readme: ## README.md # Disaster Data Releases from Planet Labs PBC Imagery from the [Planet Crisis Response Program](https://www.planet.com/disasterdata/) for major disaster events — earthquakes, floods, storms, wildfires and human-made disasters — as a single browsable catalog. Each event is a self-contained sub-catalog with pre- and post-event high-resolution COGs (visual, pansharpened-analytic and usable-data masks), organised by affected location. Imagery © Planet Labs PBC, licensed [CC-BY-NC-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/) (non-commercial). This is a [Portolan](https://portolan-sdi.org) / [STAC](https://stacspec.org) catalog: the umbrella root (`catalog.json`) links to one self-contained sub-catalog per disaster event, and new events are added as new sub-catalogs. - **Browse now:** [open in the Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/catalog.json) - **Root catalog:** [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/catalog.json) - **Agent / LLM guide:** [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/llms.txt) — point Claude Code or another agent at it to explore and query the data - **License:** [CC-BY-NC-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/) (non-commercial) — © Planet Labs PBC - **Contact:** Planet Crisis Response Program — [crisis-response@planet.com](mailto:crisis-response@planet.com) ## Events ### [Planet Crisis Response — Gironde/Landes Wildfire, France (2026)](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026) Planet Crisis Response Program imagery documenting the July 2026 Gironde/Landes Atlantic wildfire complex near Bordeaux, southwestern France (the Le Porge → Arès run). The fire started ~23 July 2026, burned an estimated ~34,000–45,000 ha of Landes pine forest and coastal dune habitat around the Arcachon Basin, prompting ~250,000 evacuations and activation of the EU Civil Protection Mechanism. Includes pre-event baseline and post-containment very-high-resolution SkySat (~0.7 m) and PlanetScope (~3 m) imagery. - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026) - Agent guide: [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026/llms.txt) ### [Planet Crisis Response — Venezuela Earthquake (2026)](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24) Planet Crisis Response Program imagery documenting the 24 June 2026 earthquake that struck Venezuela's coast, causing extensive damage in Caracas, La Guaira, Catia La Mar, Puerto Cabello, Valencia, Ocumare de la Costa and Yumare. - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24) - Agent guide: [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/llms.txt) ### [Planet Crisis Response — Philippines Earthquake (2026)](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/philippines-earthquake-2026-06-08) Planet Crisis Response Program imagery documenting the 8 June 2026 earthquake in the southern Philippines (Mindanao). - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/philippines-earthquake-2026-06-08/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/philippines-earthquake-2026-06-08/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/philippines-earthquake-2026-06-08/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/philippines-earthquake-2026-06-08) - Agent guide: [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/philippines-earthquake-2026-06-08/llms.txt) ### [Planet Crisis Response — Hurricane Melissa, Jamaica (2025)](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025) Planet Crisis Response Program imagery documenting Hurricane Melissa's impact on Jamaica. - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025) - Agent guide: [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/llms.txt) ## Using the catalog **Browse** the whole catalog in the [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/catalog.json), or open `https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/catalog.json` in any STAC browser. **Explore with AI.** Point [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) or another agent at [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/llms.txt) (each event has its own too) and ask it to query the data, make maps, or compare pre/post-event imagery. **Query with DuckDB.** Every collection has a STAC-GeoParquet `items.parquet` index of its scenes (id, datetime, geometry, cloud cover, asset hrefs): ```sql INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial; SELECT id, datetime, assets FROM read_parquet( 'https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata//post-event/items.parquet' ); ``` **Open a COG.** Asset hrefs are absolute public URLs — stream just the pixels you need with `/vsicurl`, rio-tiler, rasterio or GDAL, no download or API key required. --- *Imagery © Planet Labs PBC — [Crisis Response Program](https://www.planet.com/disasterdata/) (CC BY-NC 4.0). Contact: [crisis-response@planet.com](mailto:crisis-response@planet.com).*
